entities.name: Muhammad Ibn Masud al-Ayyashi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muḥammad ibn Mas'ūd al-ʾAyyāshi al-Samarqandi, known as Ayyashi, was a 10th century Twelver Shia Muslim scholar, jurist (faqīh) and mufassir from Samarkand. He had many known works in the field of exegesis of the Quran, Fiqh, Arabic literature and hadith. His exegesis of the Quran, known as Tafsir Ayyashi, is his most famous book.
